title: Titus Chapter 2 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Titus chapter 2 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Titus Chapter 2 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Titus Chapter 2.

questions.question: In Titus 2, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Speak thou the things which become sound doctrine
The aged men be sober, grave, temperate
The aged women be teachers of good things
Teach the young women to love their husbands
questions.correctAnswer: Speak thou the things which become sound doctrine
questions.explanation: Titus 2:1 commands to speak the things which become sound doctrine, and this is the first instruction in the chapter.

questions.question: According to Titus 2:2, how should aged men behave?
options: Sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience
questions.correctAnswer: Sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience
questions.explanation: Titus 2:2 describes the behavior expected of aged men as sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

questions.question: What are aged women instructed NOT to be, according to Titus 2:3?
options: False accusers and not given to much wine
questions.correctAnswer: False accusers and not given to much wine
questions.explanation: Titus 2:3 states aged women should not be false accusers nor given to much wine.

questions.question: In Titus 2:3, what positive role should aged women take on?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:3 says aged women are to be teachers of good things.

questions.question: According to Titus 2:4, what are aged women to teach the young women?
options: To be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children
questions.correctAnswer: To be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children
questions.explanation: Titus 2:4 instructs aged women to teach young women to be sober, to love their husbands, and to love their children.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a characteristic young women should have in Titus 2:5?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:5 lists discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, but does not mention wealthy.

questions.question: What is the reason given in Titus 2:5 for young women to be obedient to their husbands?
options: That the word of God be not blasphemed
questions.correctAnswer: That the word of God be not blasphemed
questions.explanation: Titus 2:5 says young women should be obedient to their husbands so that the word of God be not blasphemed.

questions.question: What does Titus 2:1 instruct to speak about?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:1 instructs to speak the things which become sound doctrine.

questions.question: In Titus 2:2, which virtues are aged men described as being sound in?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:2 says aged men should be sound in faith, charity, and patience.

questions.question: According to Titus 2:3, aged women should behave in a way that becometh what?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:3 states aged women should be in behaviour as becometh holiness.

questions.question: What is one of the behaviors young women are taught to have in Titus 2:5?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:5 includes 'good' as a characteristic young women should have.

questions.question: True or False: Titus 2:4 instructs aged women to teach young women to love their children.
questions.explanation: Titus 2:4 says aged women should teach young women to love their children.

questions.question: True or False: Titus 2:2 states that aged men should be temperate.
questions.explanation: Titus 2:2 says aged men should be temperate among other qualities.

questions.question: True or False: Titus 2:3 says aged women should be given to much wine.
questions.explanation: Titus 2:3 explicitly says aged women should NOT be given to much wine.

questions.question: True or False: Titus 2:5 instructs young women to seek leadership roles in the church.
questions.explanation: Titus 2:5 does not mention young women seeking leadership roles; it instructs them to be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, and obedient.

medium.title: Titus Chapter 2 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Titus Chapter 2 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Titus 2:6, what are young men exhorted to be?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:6 specifically commands young men to be sober minded.

questions.question: What does Titus 2:8 promise will happen if someone shows sound speech as Titus 2:7 commands?
options: The opposite party will be ashamed
They will be praised by all
They will be free from all troubles
questions.correctAnswer: The opposite party will be ashamed
questions.explanation: Titus 2:8 states that sound speech will cause those of the contrary part to be ashamed, having no evil thing to say.

questions.question: What qualities should one show to be a pattern of good works according to Titus 2:7?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:7 specifies that one should show uncorruptness, gravity, and sincerity as a pattern of good works.

questions.question: How are servants instructed to behave toward their masters in Titus 2:9 and Titus 2:10?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:9 commands servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and Titus 2:10 adds that they should show good fidelity.

questions.question: Why should servants not purloin according to Titus 2:10?
options: So they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour
questions.correctAnswer: So they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour
questions.explanation: Titus 2:10 explains that servants should not purloin so that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

questions.question: What is the significance of being sober minded as exhorted in Titus 2:6 in practical Christian living?
options: It helps young men exercise self-control and sound judgment
questions.correctAnswer: It helps young men exercise self-control and sound judgment
questions.explanation: Titus 2:6 calls young men to be sober minded, which implies self-control and sound judgment vital for faithful living.

questions.question: What does Titus 2:8 imply about the effect of sound speech on those who oppose Christian teaching?
options: They will have no evil thing to say and be ashamed
They will try to discredit the speaker
questions.correctAnswer: They will have no evil thing to say and be ashamed
questions.explanation: Titus 2:8 states that sound speech will make those of the contrary part ashamed and unable to find evil to say.

questions.question: How does Titus 2:7 describe the manner in which one should teach doctrine?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:7 instructs showing uncorruptness, gravity, and sincerity in doctrine.

questions.question: What attitude toward masters is emphasized for servants in Titus 2:9?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:9 exhorts servants to be obedient and to please their masters well in all things.

questions.question: What does Titus 2:10 say about how servants should demonstrate fidelity?
options: By not purloining and showing good fidelity
questions.correctAnswer: By not purloining and showing good fidelity
questions.explanation: Titus 2:10 commands servants not to purloin but to show all good fidelity.

questions.question: What is the broader purpose of the instructions given to servants in Titus 2:9-10?
options: To adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things
questions.correctAnswer: To adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things
questions.explanation: Titus 2:10 clarifies that faithful behavior adorns the doctrine of God our Saviour.

questions.question: How can a Christian's good works and sincere doctrine affect their reputation according to Titus 2:7-8?
options: It silences critics and shows a godly example
questions.correctAnswer: It silences critics and shows a godly example
questions.explanation: Titus 2:7-8 teaches that good works and sound speech cause those who oppose to be ashamed, demonstrating a godly example.

questions.question: What does Titus 2:6-7 suggest about the relationship between sober-mindedness and being a pattern of good works?
options: Being sober minded enables one to be a good example
Good works make one sober minded
Sober-mindedness is only for old men
questions.correctAnswer: Being sober minded enables one to be a good example
questions.explanation: Titus 2:6 calls for sober-mindedness and Titus 2:7 links that to showing oneself a pattern of good works.

questions.question: According to Titus 2:9, how should servants respond to their masters' instructions?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:9 instructs servants to be obedient and not to answer again, indicating submission to their masters' instructions.

questions.question: Titus 2:10 teaches that servants should purloin when necessary to survive.
questions.explanation: Titus 2:10 explicitly commands servants not to purloin but to show good fidelity.

hard.title: Titus Chapter 2 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Titus Chapter 2.

questions.question: What does the grace of God bring according to Titus 2:11?
questions.explanation: The grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men (Titus 2:11).

questions.question: According to Titus 2:12, how should we live in this present world?
questions.explanation: We should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world (Titus 2:12).

questions.question: What are we looking for according to Titus 2:13?
questions.explanation: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ (Titus 2:13).

questions.question: What did Jesus give himself for according to Titus 2:14?
options: To redeem us from all iniquity
questions.correctAnswer: To redeem us from all iniquity
questions.explanation: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity (Titus 2:14).

questions.question: What authority should be used when speaking according to Titus 2:15?
questions.explanation: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority (Titus 2:15).

questions.question: What does 'soberly' mean in Greek in Titus 2:12?
questions.explanation: 'Soberly' in Greek means to be clear-headed or self-controlled, reflecting the call to live wisely (Titus 2:12).

questions.question: Which literary technique is used in Titus 2:14 when referring to Jesus redeeming a peculiar people?
questions.explanation: The structure of calling the redeemed a peculiar people serves as an inclusio, framing the chapter's teaching on living distinctively.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of salvation in Titus 2:11?
questions.explanation: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved (Romans 10:13) connects with the theme of salvation found in Titus 2:11.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of good works in Titus 2:14?
questions.explanation: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works (Ephesians 2:10) resonates with the theme of being zealous for good works in Titus 2:14.

questions.question: What comes before the instruction to be sober-minded in Titus 2:6?
questions.explanation: The instruction to teach aged women precedes the exhortation to young men to be sober-minded (Titus 2:6).

questions.question: What comes after the exhortation to deny ungodliness in Titus 2:12?
questions.explanation: The call to live soberly leads directly to looking for that blessed hope (Titus 2:12-13).

questions.question: The Greek word 'agape' in Titus 2:2 means what?
questions.explanation: 'Agape' refers to a selfless, unconditional love, which is essential in the context of charity and relationships (Titus 2:2).

questions.question: The literary technique used in Titus 2:12 is what?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:12 contrasts the denial of ungodliness with the call to live righteously, highlighting the duality of Christian living.

questions.question: True or False: The grace of God has not appeared to all men according to Titus 2:11.
questions.explanation: The grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men (Titus 2:11), making the statement false.

questions.question: True or False: We are called to be zealous of good works according to Titus 2:14.
questions.explanation: He might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works (Titus 2:14), making the statement true.

theological.title: Titus Chapter 2 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Titus Chapter 2 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Titus 2:11 teach about salvation?
options: The grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men
Salvation is earned by works and adherence to the law
Only a select few receive the grace that leads to salvation
Salvation is an ongoing process without a definitive start
questions.correctAnswer: The grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men
questions.explanation: Titus 2:11 states explicitly that the grace of God bringing salvation has appeared to all men, emphasizing the universal offer of salvation by grace, not by works or exclusivity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Titus 2:14 teach about Christ's redemptive work?
options: Christ gave Himself to redeem us from all iniquity and to purify a peculiar people zealous of good works
Christ's sacrifice redeems only those predestined to salvation
Christ redeems humanity by abolishing the law
Christ's atonement is symbolic and not efficacious for sin
questions.correctAnswer: Christ gave Himself to redeem us from all iniquity and to purify a peculiar people zealous of good works
questions.explanation: Titus 2:14 explicitly states that Christ gave Himself for us to redeem from all iniquity and purify a peculiar people, establishing the doctrine of substitutionary atonement and sanctification.

questions.question: What doctrine does Titus 2:12 teach about sanctification?
options: Grace teaches us to deny ungodliness and worldly lusts and to live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present world
Sanctification is irrelevant to the Christian life
Living righteously is only for the Old Testament believers
Worldly lusts should be indulged to demonstrate freedom in Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Grace teaches us to deny ungodliness and worldly lusts and to live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present world
questions.explanation: Titus 2:12 teaches that grace instructs believers to deny ungodliness and live in a godly manner, thus presenting sanctification as a grace-driven, ethical transformation.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Titus 2:13 specifically demonstrate?
options: The blessed hope and the glorious appearing of Jesus Christ demonstrate God's faithfulness
questions.correctAnswer: The blessed hope and the glorious appearing of Jesus Christ demonstrate God's faithfulness
questions.explanation: Titus 2:13 speaks of looking for the blessed hope and the glorious appearing of Jesus Christ, highlighting God's faithfulness to His promises.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted in Titus 2:11 concerning God's grace?
options: Grace as an expression of God's mercy
questions.correctAnswer: Grace as an expression of God's mercy
questions.explanation: Titus 2:11 presents grace as God's merciful initiative to bring salvation to all men, demonstrating divine mercy and grace.

questions.question: How does Titus 2 connect to the broader biblical narrative of sanctification?
options: It prepares believers for the final judgment by emphasizing godly living
It contradicts the teachings of the Old Testament on holiness
It dismisses the need for personal holiness in favor of doctrine
It focuses solely on ecclesiastical order without moral implications
questions.correctAnswer: It prepares believers for the final judgment by emphasizing godly living
questions.explanation: Titus 2 emphasizes sober, righteous, and godly living in light of the blessed hope (2:12-13), preparing believers for final judgment consistent with themes in 2 Corinthians 5:10.

questions.question: In what way does Titus 2:9-10 relate redemptive history to social ethics?
options: It teaches servants to adorn the doctrine of God through obedience, reflecting Christ's humility
It promotes social rebellion as a sign of faith
It denies any ethical responsibilities in social relationships
It focuses only on spiritual salvation without social implications
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches servants to adorn the doctrine of God through obedience, reflecting Christ's humility
questions.explanation: Titus 2:9-10 exhorts servants to obey and please their masters to adorn God's doctrine, connecting redemptive humility with social ethics as seen also in Philippians 2:5-8.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Titus 2:7 and Titus 2:8 teach about Christian witness?
options: Believers must demonstrate good works, uncorrupt doctrine, gravity, sincerity, and sound speech to silence critics
Christian witness is based solely on doctrinal correctness without behavior
Good works are irrelevant if speech is sound
Sincerity can compensate for poor doctrine
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must demonstrate good works, uncorrupt doctrine, gravity, sincerity, and sound speech to silence critics
questions.explanation: Titus 2:7-8 calls believers to be a pattern of good works and sound speech so that opponents have nothing evil to say, teaching a holistic doctrine of witness combining ethics and doctrine.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Titus 2:2 and Titus 2:3 teach regarding the role of older believers?
options: Older men and women must exemplify sobriety, holiness, and teach good things to instruct younger generations
Older believers have no responsibility toward younger believers
Holiness is only required of the young
Teaching is reserved for clergy only
questions.correctAnswer: Older men and women must exemplify sobriety, holiness, and teach good things to instruct younger generations
questions.explanation: Titus 2:2-3 instructs older men to be sober and sound in faith and older women to teach good things, showing a doctrine of generational discipleship and holy example.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Titus 2:4 and Titus 2:5 teach about Christian household ethics?
options: Young women are taught to love their husbands and children and to be discreet and obedient to prevent blasphemy of God's word
Household roles are unimportant for Christian witness
Children should be independent and rebellious to foster strength
Obedience in the home is a cultural suggestion, not theological
questions.correctAnswer: Young women are taught to love their husbands and children and to be discreet and obedient to prevent blasphemy of God's word
questions.explanation: Titus 2:4-5 teaches young women to love family members and be obedient so the word of God is not blasphemed, affirming household ethics as integral to Christian doctrine.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Titus 2:11-12 encourages legalism by demanding ethical living. What does the passage actually teach?
options: Grace instructs believers to deny ungodliness and live godly, showing that ethical living flows from grace, not law
Ethical living is required to earn salvation through grace
Grace nullifies the need for any moral conduct
Salvation is reserved for moral perfectionists only
questions.correctAnswer: Grace instructs believers to deny ungodliness and live godly, showing that ethical living flows from grace, not law
questions.explanation: Titus 2:11-12 teaches that grace appears to instruct believers to live godly lives, denying legalism by emphasizing grace as the basis for ethical transformation.

questions.question: What doctrine does Titus 2:6 teach about the character formation of young men?
options: Young men are exhorted to be sober minded, showing the importance of self-control and maturity
Young men are encouraged to pursue worldly pleasures
Character formation is unnecessary for young men
Sober mindedness is only for elders
questions.correctAnswer: Young men are exhorted to be sober minded, showing the importance of self-control and maturity
questions.explanation: Titus 2:6 exhorts young men to be sober minded, highlighting the doctrine that maturity and self-control are essential for Christian character.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated in Titus 2:14 by Christ's self-giving for redemption?
questions.explanation: Titus 2:14 shows Christ giving Himself to redeem and purify, demonstrating God's attribute of love through the sacrificial act.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Titus 2:9 and Titus 2:10 teach about the relationship between Christian faith and social ethics in the context of servants and masters?
options: Servants must obey their masters and show good fidelity to adorn the doctrine of God our Savior
Servants should seek to overthrow their masters as a sign of faith
Faith is entirely separate from social conduct
questions.correctAnswer: Servants must obey their masters and show good fidelity to adorn the doctrine of God our Savior
questions.explanation: Titus 2:9-10 teaches servants to obey and be faithful to their masters to adorn God's doctrine, integrating social ethics with Christian witness.

questions.question: How does Titus 2:15 emphasize the authority of apostolic teaching in the church?
options: Paul commands to speak, exhort, and rebuke with all authority, forbidding anyone to despise the teacher
Teaching should be casual and optional without authority
Rebuke is discouraged to maintain peace
Authority is only given to church elders, not teachers
questions.correctAnswer: Paul commands to speak, exhort, and rebuke with all authority, forbidding anyone to despise the teacher
questions.explanation: Titus 2:15 commands the teacher to exercise authoritative teaching and rebuke, underscoring the apostolic authority in church instruction.
